text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day Sheffield Shield cricket matches on Friday.
In Sydney: Tasmania 463-7 declared (Jamie Cox 143, Michael DiVenuto 65, Ricky Ponting 64, David Boon 52); New South Wales 220-3 (Michael Slater 87, Jason Arnberger 56 not out).
In Brisbane: Queensland 277 and 194-7 (Matthew Mott 60, Stuart Law 50); South Australia 160 (Jamie Siddons 82; Michael Kasprowicz 5-64)
In Melbourne: Victoria 205 (Shawn Craig 90); Western Australia 367-4 (Mike Hussey 124 not out, Ryan Campbell 113, Murray Goodwin 90).
